deck_ui.craftbound.switch_hint: Neutral cards stay; incompatible class cards leave the deck list.

card.craftbound.ravager.text: No ability. It's just very big.

card.craftbound.enchanted_golden_apple.t: Give a friendly mob invulnerability: it takes no damage until your next turn.

keyword.craftbound.sprint.desc: Can attack enemy mobs and blocks immediately, but cannot attack the enemy hero until your next turn.
match_ui.craftbound.status.sprint_board_: Sprint: mobs and blocks only this turn
keyword.craftbound.ignore_shield.desc: Can attack any enemy even while enemies have Shield. Other attack restrictions still apply. On a tool, applies to your hero's attacks.
keyword.craftbound.ranged.desc: Can attack blocks behind enemy mobs. Shield still takes priority. Trades damage normally.
keyword.craftbound.spawn.desc: Happens when you play this card.
keyword.craftbound.block.desc: Stays in the back row. Enemy melee attacks can reach it once your mob row is empty.
card_class.craftbound.neutral.desc: Any deck can use this card.

card_class.craftbound.farmer.desc: Protect Crops to grow your maximum XP.

binder_ui.craftbound.hint_take_enchanted: Ctrl+click: take an Enchanted copy (Ctrl+Shift: all)
binder_ui.craftbound.add_all_hint: Move loose cards from your inventory into this binder. Extra copies are automatically disenchanted.
binder_ui.craftbound.disenchant_hint: A binder keeps 2 normal and 2 Enchanted copies of each card (1 of each for Legendaries). This breaks down anything over that into experience.

card.craftbound.diamond_sword.text: Your hero can attack for 5. Lasts 2 attacks.
card.craftbound.sweeping_edge.text: Deal damage equal to your tool's attack to every enemy mob.
card.craftbound.furnace.text: %s. At the end of your turn, heal your hero 2.
card.craftbound.dispenser.text: %s. At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
card.craftbound.piston.text: Push a mob back into its owner's hand.

card_ui.craftbound.tool_attack.desc: How hard your hero hits with this tool.

power.craftbound.none.desc: This hero has no class power.

match_ui.craftbound.pause_waiting: Waiting for your opponent. The request expires after 30 seconds.

match_ui.craftbound.waiting_card_master: The Card Master is on the way to the table... (right-click the table to cancel)
match_ui.craftbound.waiting_player: Waiting for another player to ready up at this table... (right-click it to cancel)
match_ui.craftbound.stopped_waiting: You stopped waiting at the table

table_ui.craftbound.player_hint: You'll wait at the table until another player readies up here.
table_ui.craftbound.card_master_hint: The Card Master will walk over and stand across the table from you.
card_class.craftbound.alchemist.desc: Control the board with potions and precise damage.

card_class.craftbound.miner.desc: Gather ore to strengthen your mobs.

card_class.craftbound.chef.desc: Feed allies, restore Health and sustain your board.
deck_ui.craftbound.class_blurb.chef: Food, healing and steady board support.
card_class.craftbound.tamer.desc: Raise a pack of tameable companions.

power.craftbound.strike.desc: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn.
power.craftbound.throw_potion.desc: Deal 1 damage to a mob, block or hero.
